run_STSEval: run STSEval to compute Pearson and Spearman correlations on semantic textual similarity datasets
create_STSEval_loadFile: create STSEval instance and load STS input and ground truth score files from a directory
test_STS12Eval: test STS12Eval on MSRpar, MSRvid, SMTeuroparl, surprise.OnWN, and surprise.SMTnews datasets
test_STS14Eval: test STS14Eval on deft-forum, deft-news, headlines, images, OnWN, and tweet-news datasets
run_STSBenchmarkEval: run STSBenchmarkEval on sts-train, sts-dev, and sts-test CSV files for supervised semantic similarity
